match.title: Bangladesh vs Australia
match.h2h: Australia dominates the overall head-to-head cricket record against Bangladesh with 32 wins across 41 matches in all major formats. While Australia has historically held upper-hand control over the matchup, Bangladesh 9 Has managed hard-fought home series victories, particularly in the shorter formats of the game. Below is the comprehensive head-to-head breakdown for men's international cricket as of August 2026.🔍 Key Format Takeaways One Day Internationals (ODIs): Australia leads 20–3. Bangladesh's first historic win came in Cardiff in 2005. Most recently, Bangladesh Pulled off back-to-back home victories against a touring Australian side in June 2026, winning the 3-match series 2–1. Twenty20 Internationals (T20 Is): Australia holds a 7–4 edge. Bangladesh notoriously secured a historic 4–1 home series victory over Australia in 2021. However, Australia struck back by sweeping their latest 3-match bilateral series 3–0 in mid-2026. Test Matches: Australia is dominant at 5–1. Bangladesh claimed their sole historic Test win against Australia by 20 runs in Dhaka back in August 2017.
